explication: Penpot is a browser-based collaborative design platform with a backend, editor-specific text and rendering runtimes, and extension surfaces. The principal workflow is a designer editing a document, collaborating with a team, and using design-system and developer-facing capabilities to carry the result toward implementation. The README documents these product relationships; the source index identifies several substantial runtime modules, but much of the application wiring was not sampled, so the graph avoids asserting detailed internal call chains.
